'''AC Oulu''' is a Finnish professional [[association football|football club]] based in [[Oulu]], currently playing in Finland's premier division, ''Veikkausliiga''. Formed in 2002, the club have played six seasons in Finland's highest football league [[Veikkausliiga]] and 16 seasons in the [[Ykkönen|second highest league]]. They currently play their home games at [[Heinäpää Football Stadium]], and the club colours are navy blue, and white."}}
